##### Project general facts

MAG 22 by MAG is a residential development offering 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhouses. Positioned as a signature collection, the project focuses on exclusivity and comfort, with its name inspired by the number 22, which the developer associates with strength and distinction. The townhouses are designed for families and professionals seeking spacious, private homes in a calm environment.

Residents can enjoy a range of lifestyle amenities, including equestrian facilities, a dedicated cycling track, golf courses and retail outlets. Each townhouse also features a shaded rooftop terrace and thoughtfully designed outdoor living spaces, providing private areas for relaxation, gatherings and enjoying the open air.

The architecture is timeless and refined, with clean lines and careful attention to detail. Open-plan layouts give the interiors a sense of scale and contemporary comfort, while the outdoor areas create a natural visual flow into the living spaces. The townhouses come with fully equipped kitchens and are delivered fully furnished, allowing residents to move in without additional setup.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Nad Al Sheba, a residential district just minutes from central Dubai, known for its quiet atmosphere and spacious communities. The area sits close to Meydan and Meydan Racecourse and offers quick connections to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and major highways, making daily commuting smooth and efficient.

Nad Al Sheba is characterised by low-density developments, villas and boutique residential projects, creating a calm and private environment. The district features green open spaces, cycling tracks and leisure facilities, while schools, healthcare centres and retail options are within a short drive.

Despite its tranquil setting, Nad Al Sheba remains well connected to the city's main destinations, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport. This balance of suburban comfort and urban accessibility makes the area attractive for families and professionals.
